products_page.title: Imikhiqizo eyisikhombisa, [[ukusebenza okukodwa]]
products_page.text: Umkhiqizo ngamunye uxazulula indawo. Ndawonye babelana ngamakhasimende, isitoko, ama-oda nezinkokhelo.

fullvendor.lead: Isikhungo sokusebenza kwakho kwezohwebo: ama-oda, izintengo, isitoko namakhasimende endaweni eyodwa.
fullvendor.about: FullVendor ithatha indawo yamaspredishithi namasistimu axegayo osisabalalisi. Kusuka lapha kuphuma ama-oda, kubhekwane nempahla, iphothifoliyo yamakhasimende iyanakekelwa futhi nezinombolo zosuku ziyabhekwa. Yonke ingxenye ye-ecosystem ixhuma kulesi sisekelo.

benefits.title: Ingcweti yedatha eyodwa
benefits.text: Amakhasimende, imikhiqizo kanye nezintengo kwabelwana ngazo nokuthengisa, indawo yokugcina impahla kanye nezezimali.

benefits.title: Sula ukusebenza kwansuku zonke
benefits.text: Ama-oda, ukuthenga nesitoko kuyeka ukuhlala ngamafayela ahlukene.

benefits.title: Imibiko yokunquma

benefits.title: Ilungele ukukhula

erp.lead: Ukuphatha kanye nezezimali, okuhambisana nalokho okuthengiswayo nokulethwa.
erp.about: FullVendor ERP ihlanganisa ukubalwa kwezimali, ama-invoyisi kagesi, izinkokhelo, izimpahla ezingashintshi kanye nezinkampani eziningi. Kuthatha ukusebenza kwezentengiselwano futhi kuguqule kube okufakiwe, amarisidi kanye nezitatimende indawo yezezimali engazisebenzisa.

benefits.title: I-accounting exhunyiwe

benefits.title: Amarisidi e-elekthronikhi

resources.intro: Imihlahlandlela emifushane yabaphathi bokusabalalisa abazonquma ukuthi iyiphi isistimu okumele banamathele kuyo.

unify.title: Ukuhlanganisa kanjani ukusatshalaliswa kusistimu eyodwa
unify.summary: Okufanele ukuhlanganise kuqala lapho ukuthengisa, inqolobane namaqoqo kuhlala ngamafayela ahlukene.
points: Qala ngamakhasimende, imikhiqizo kanye namanani: bangothisha abasetshenziswa wonke umuntu.
Xhuma i-oda nesitoko ngaphambi kokwengeza ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
Ikala inombolo elula: ama-oda agcwaliswe ngaphandle kokwenza kabusha ifomu.

offline.title: Ukuthengisa kuphoqa ukusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
offline.summary: Yini okufanele uyifune kuhlelo lokusebenza loku-oda ukuze umdayisi angayeki ngenxa yesiginali.
points: Ikhathalogi kanye nesikhwama semali kufanele kube ocingweni, hhayi nje emafini.
I-oda lilondolozwa kudivayisi futhi liyalayishwa uma inethiwekhi ibuya.
Lapho uvumelanisa, i-oda selivele lingena esitolo.

warehouse.title: Isitolo esinebhakhodi, ngaphandle kwephepha
warehouse.summary: Ungasuka kanjani ohlwini oluphrintiwe uye ekukhetheni okuqinisekisiwe ocingweni.
points: Thola ngokumelene ne-oda lokuthenga, hhayi ngokumelene nememori.
Qinisekisa into ngayinye uma uhlukanisa. Isiphazamisi singena ephasishi.

finance.title: Iqoqo liqondaniswe nendali
finance.summary: Kungani umthengisi kufanele abone isikweletu sekhasimende ngaphambi kokuthatha elinye i-oda.
points: Ukuvakasha yisikhathi esingcono kakhulu sokuqoqa, uma isikweletu sibonakala.
Ukuthengisa nezezimali kufanele kubheke ikhasimende elifanayo.
Umbiko wansuku zonke owedlule isikhathi ubaluleke ngaphezu kokuvala sekwephuzile.

legal.privacy_intro: Le nqubomgomo ichaza ukuthi senzani ngedatha oyishiya kumafomu kule sayithi.

privacy.title: Iyiphi idatha esiyiqoqayo
privacy.text: Uma ucela idemo noma usibhalele, sigcina igama, inkampani, i-imeyili, inombolo yocingo uma uyibonisa, izwe, usayizi weqembu, umkhiqizo onentshisekelo kuwo kanye nomlayezo. Siphinde sirekhode idethi, ulimi lwekhasi kanye nekheli le-IP, ukuvimbela ukuthunyelwa okuhlukumezayo.

privacy.title: Sizisebenziselani?
privacy.text: Sisebenzisa le datha kuphela ukuze sikuphendule, sixhumanise idemo futhi silungiselele isiphakamiso sezentengiso. Asizithengisi noma sizinike uhlu lwezinkampani zangaphandle.

privacy.title: Zigcinwa kuphi futhi isikhathi esingakanani?
privacy.text: Izicelo zigcinwa kuseva yale sayithi. Sizigcina ngesikhathi esidingekayo ukuze sikunikeze usizo kanye nokulandelelwa kwezentengiso, futhi siyazisusa uma usicela noma lapho zingasadingeki.

privacy.title: Amalungelo akho
privacy.text: Ungacela ukufinyelela, ukulungiswa noma ukususwa kwedatha yakho efomini lokuxhumana, elibonisa emlayezo. Uma inkampani ishicilela i-imeyili kule webhusayithi, ungabhala nalapho.

legal.terms_intro: Le mibandela iyasebenza ekusetshenzisweni kwalesi sizindalwazi se-FullVendor.

terms.title: Ulwazi lwezohwebo
terms.text: Imibhalo, isibonelo izibalo zedeshibhodi nezincazelo zethula inkundla. Angalungiswa lapho umkhiqizo ushintsha futhi akuwona ukunikezwa okuvaliwe.

terms.title: Idemo ayiyona inkontileka
terms.text: Ukuhambisa ifomu akudali isibopho sokuthenga noma ukugodla inani. Noma iyiphi inkontileka kuvunyelwana ngayo ngokwehlukana, ngokubhaliwe, nobubanzi bayo nemibandela.

terms.title: Okuqukethwe kwesayithi
terms.text: FullVendor uphawu lokuhweba, amagama emikhiqizo nokuqukethwe kwalawa makhasi kungokwabanikazi bawo. Azikwazi ukukopishwa ukwethula omunye umkhiqizo.

terms.title: Ukusetshenziswa okwamukelekayo
terms.text: Ungasebenzisi amafomu ukuze uhambise ulwazi olungamanga, ugaxekile noma okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni. Singase sizibe izicelo ezingahambisani nengxoxo yebhizinisi yangempela.
